title: Taeniidae Ludwig 1886
author: Poglayen, Giovanni
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-zero
materials: was used in samples without clear sequencing results to confirm the species of those samples. The amplicons were directly sequenced after purification of the PCR products using the MinElute ® PCR purification kit (Qiagen). Sequencing was performed by Synergene Biotech GmbH, Biotech Center Zurich, Switzerland (http://www.synergenebiotech.com). Primer Cest5 and Cest5seq was used for non- Echinococcus cestodes including Taenia spp. and Cest5 for E . granulosus , while primer nad1 T-Rv for Taenia spp. for amplicons obtained with multiplex-PCR and nad1 PCR, respectively. Sequences were compared with the one present in GenBank using Blast tool (http:// www.blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov).

steps.title: Select specimens for analysis
steps.instruction: Choose 130 specimens from 54 wolves that are not dog or wolf × dog hybrids, based on genetic profile and material abundance, for taeniidae egg examination.

steps.title: Sieving fecal samples
steps.instruction: Weigh up to 2 g of each fecal sample, sieve it through a 150 µm mesh filter, and wash the retained material several times in a cup.

steps.title: Centrifuge filtrate and collect pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the wash filtrate at 1600 × g for 10 minutes and collect the resulting pellet.

steps.title: Isolate and identify taeniid eggs
steps.instruction: Isolate taeniid eggs from the pellet using the flotation and sieving method of Mathis et al. (1996) and examine the eggs morphologically under an inverted microscope.

steps.title: Extract DNA from selected samples
steps.instruction: Perform DNA extraction on all egg‑positive samples and on 14 egg‑negative samples (used as negative controls) using the complete sieving fraction as described by Stefanić et al. (2004).

steps.title: Perform multiplex PCR on samples
steps.instruction: Run a multiplex‑PCR on a total of 69 DNA samples to discriminate E. granulosus, E. multilocularis and other cestodes (including Taenia spp.) according to Trachsel et al. (2007).

steps.title: Repeat PCR for E. granulosus positives
steps.instruction: For samples that tested positive for E. granulosus, repeat the PCR using only the E. granulosus primers Cest5 and Cest4, keeping the same reaction conditions, and send the resulting amplicons for sequencing.

steps.title: Amplify nad1 gene for ambiguous samples
steps.instruction: For samples without clear sequencing results, perform a second PCR targeting the nad1 gene using the primers described by Armua‑Fernandez et al. (2011) to confirm species identity.

steps.title: Purify PCR products and send for sequencing
steps.instruction: Purify all PCR amplicons with the MinElute® PCR purification kit (Qiagen) and submit the purified products to Synergene Biotech GmbH (Zurich, Switzerland) for direct sequencing.

steps.title: Compare sequences using BLAST
steps.instruction: Compare the obtained sequences with those in GenBank using the NCBI BLAST tool (http://www.blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov).
